Public redistribution permission — 2026-11-01
===========================================

The repository owner confirmed on 2026-11-01 that the City Flight author
has authorized public redistribution of the imported code. This supersedes
the historical README.txt statement limiting the import to the hackathon.
The imported revision remains c8f5e9873b1bd487b6af6c16b77875b196f42a91.

The reported permission allows inclusion in public source releases; it
is not recorded here as an unrestricted license to sublicense, modify, or
sell every component. Preserve any additional terms in the author's grant.
No MIT/Apache/GPL license for the author's original additions is invented by
this notice. Agree explicit downstream reuse terms with the author if needed.

JsbExact also derives from JSBSim. See JSBSIM_NOTICES.txt for upstream library
copyright/License attribution and the C172 aircraft model's no-sale notice.
The author of the port cannot waive third-party rights in its inputs.
